column5: yibQ, Predicted polysaccharide deacetylase; This RNA is fit for the anaerobic condition viability
atoB, acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase; This RNA is fit for the anaerobic condition viability
folB, dihydroneopterin aldolase; needed for growth (METHYLENE-THF) in acetate condition

pyrE, orotate phosphoribosyltransferase. Without this adjustment, basal mRNA is near 0.04 copies per cell, so pyrE arrives in rare bursts and can go extinct between bursts, stopping UTP synthesis. Raising expression here makes bursts frequent enough to prevent extinction (a small count is still fine because flux magnitude does not need to increase, since the FBA reaction is currently only limited by whether the enzyme is present or not). Note that this value was originally 10 in vEcoli and 4 here (as of 11/21/26), and assigning PyrE a more stable half-life in translation.py allowed sims in both to succeed at 4, but removing the adjustment entirely still led to pyrE extinction (the overall goal is to not have any expression adjustment).
